# MediaPipe Pose Debug Visualization Project

This is a React + TypeScript + Vite project for visualizing MediaPipe Pose landmarks in real-time.

## Project Structure
- `/src/types` - TypeScript type definitions for pose landmarks
- `/src/hooks` - React hooks for MediaPipe integration
- `/src/utils` - Drawing utilities for canvas rendering
- `/src/components` - React components

## Tech Stack
- React 18 + TypeScript
- Vite for build tooling
- MediaPipe Pose for pose detection
- Tailwind CSS for minimal styling
